Class RecipeRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.github.pinont.singularitylib.api.recipes.RecipeRegistry
public final class RecipeRegistry extends Object
Registry helpers for custom crafting recipes (Phase 2).

Registers shaped, shapeless and furnace recipes under namespaced keys derived from plugin.getName(). Duplicate registrations are caught and logged rather than thrown.
